description: Use this when the user asks what a tier costs or bumps into a limit, so the answer is this account's actual plan rather than a guess. Show the available plans with what each includes, plus the caller's current tier and any allowance they have used. Read-only. Cannot spend money — it displays pricing and cannot start, change or cancel a subscription. Call this when a refusal names it as the recovery: an allowance is exhausted and the user is deciding what to do about it. PLANS GATE DEPTH, NEVER TRUTH — the registration verdict, its rdap_source and a domain's price are identical on every tier, and the response lists exactly what does not vary. Paying buys more of the picture, never a different answer about reality, so never present an upgrade as a way to get a better verdict.
name: show_plans
